generated_for: GS360 V6 CPU-first quality + delivery pipeline

resources.name: OpenVINO Runtime
resources.cpu_value: High-performance neural inference on CPU; supports caching, performance hints and automatic device selection.

resources.name: COLMAP
resources.cpu_value: CPU feature extraction/matching/mapping is supported; useful for multi-view pose estimation.
resources.install_hint: Use the official Windows release or existing package manager; put colmap in PATH.

resources.name: MiDaS 3.1
resources.cpu_value: Official repository documents an OpenVINO small model for Intel CPU inference.
resources.install_hint: Prefer the documented OpenVINO MiDaS small model on CPU-only machines.
resources.verify: Run one depth smoke image and compare latency/quality against GS360 proxy depth.

resources.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
resources.cpu_value: Small official model; code automatically falls back to CPU when CUDA/MPS is unavailable.
resources.install_hint: Use only the Small checkpoint in automatic permissive mode; optionally convert/wire a compatible ONNX/OpenVINO representation.
resources.verify: Benchmark one representative panorama crop before making it the default depth provider.

resources.name: Depth Anything V2 Base/Large/Giant
resources.cpu_value: Higher-capacity models but heavier and non-commercial licensed.
resources.install_hint: Do not auto-install for a commercial/unknown-use server. Require explicit license review.
resources.verify: N/A until license policy explicitly permits it.

resources.name: OpenSplat
resources.cpu_value: True 3DGS training on CPU is supported; official docs warn CPU can be about 100x slower than GPU. Supports resume and compressed output formats.
resources.install_hint: On CPU-only Windows, build from source with CPU LibTorch if acceptable under project licensing; do not silently vendor it into proprietary code.
resources.verify: opensplat --help; then train a tiny COLMAP dataset with --cpu / low iteration count.

resources.name: PlayCanvas SplatTransform
resources.cpu_value: CLI/library for cleanup, NaN/Inf filtering, decimation, SPZ/SOG/LOD/HTML export and statistics. CPU mode is available for SOG compression.

resources.name: Niantic SPZ
resources.cpu_value: Native/Python SPZ pack/unpack library. SPZ is typically around 10x smaller than PLY with minimal perceptual difference.
resources.install_hint: Optional if SplatTransform is insufficient: clone official repo and build/install Python bindings. Prefer SplatTransform first to avoid duplicate tooling.
resources.verify: Convert a copy of one trained PLY to SPZ, compare size, and visually validate before activation.

resources.name: PlayCanvas SuperSplat
resources.cpu_value: Browser-based open-source editor for inspecting, cleaning, optimizing and publishing Gaussian splats; useful as a manual/visual fallback validator.
resources.install_hint: No installation required for hosted editor; for offline/local use clone the repo, npm install, npm run develop. Do not make it a mandatory server dependency.
resources.verify: Load an exported PLY/SPZ/SOG and visually inspect holes, floaters, orientation and cropping.
